bottleneck: Glioblastoma resists every modality: tumor cells infiltrate brain diffusely beyond any surgical margin, the blood-brain barrier blocks most drugs, extreme heterogeneity plus glioma stem cells drive inevitable recurrence, and the tumor's immunosuppressive microenvironment defeats immunotherapy that works elsewhere. Median survival has barely moved in decades despite full knowledge of the tumor's genetics — sequencing revealed the mutations without revealing a vulnerability. The brain's most common malignancy is also its most untreatable, and each failed trial reinforces the sense that new drugs within old paradigms will not suffice.
current_state: Tumor-treating fields and targeted agents add months at best. Immunotherapy, effective elsewhere, largely fails behind the BBB, and no paradigm-shifting approach has emerged.

title: Glioblastoma resists all treatment modalities
why_it_blocks: A uniformly fatal brain cancer that ignores surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy exposes the limits of oncology's entire toolkit. Cracking glioblastoma requires new paradigms — not another drug in a failed class.
